title: M. P., P. C.
html_source: Abbreviations of Member of Parliament (MP) and Peace Commissioner (PC). KP probably refers to a Knight of the order of Saint Patrick, but I am less certain.

anchor.prefix: magistrate or justice of the peace with a family crest and coat of arms and appropriate classical motto (Semper paratus), duly recorded in the court directory (Bloom, Leopold P.,
anchor.suffix:
, K. P., L. L. D. honoris causa, Bloomville, Dundrum) and mentioned in court and fashionable intelligence (Mr and Mrs Leopold Bloom have left Kingstown for England).
